title: Asparagus, broad bean and pork frittata

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a plain whole food: potatoes, pork mince, broad beans, asparagus, eggs, Parmesan, rocket, fennel seeds and chives.

supermarket.reason: Every item is a mainstream Tesco line at an everyday price in May.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only an ovenproof frying pan, a whisk and a grater for the Parmesan, and the frittata technique suits a confident beginner.

works.reason: Eight eggs with potatoes, pork and vegetables makes a generous frittata for four, and 15 minutes at 200°C will set it in a large pan.

honest_times.reason: Slicing, podding and about 18 minutes of frying fit roughly within the 30 minutes of prep printed, and the 15-minute bake matches the cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: Asparagus and broad beans in an early May frittata is right for the date, and the asparagus is a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling lunch of eggs, pork, potatoes and green vegetables that a family would happily eat again.
